audit.why: 47.3% over 518 games supports TRICKY at 7/10. Command: Attack costs 35 mana on 7/6/5/4/3s at 815 range against a champion whose damage starts at 850 and whose kill range is 700, so Orianna owns the early lane and Cassiopeia takes over once she can hold 700.
audit.corrected: Rating unchanged; the stage text now says where the range line is instead of repeating the template.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[].side read Skill on six rows and gave Orianna the last one, while content win[] read Orianna, Orianna, Skill, then Cassiopeia four times. Six of seven rows rendered two different answers, including the last row rendering opposite winners.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches the content layer exactly and the whys[] describe that progression.
audit.corrected: phases[0]/[1].side Orianna, [2] Skill unchanged, [3]/[4]/[5]/[6].side Cassiopeia, with every why rewritten in the same proposal. No win[N] edits needed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page's whole interaction section was 'track the ball position like a second enemy' with no cooldowns, and it never stated the one thing that decides the matchup: Command: Shockwave launches you toward the ball, not toward Orianna.
audit.why: Command: Shockwave (R) 110/95/80s has a 410 radius around the ball and pulls enemies to it, so spacing is measured from the ball. Command: Attack (Q) leaves the ball where it lands, which is what makes the ball's position readable. Command: Protect (E) is a 9s shield that also grants armour and magic resist and can be cast on herself, so it eats a committed Twin Fang window (confirmed by _missing). Miasma's grounding has no dash to deny — Orianna has none — so it is a slow zone here, not an anti-engage tool. Petrifying Gaze reaches 825 and stuns only enemies facing Cassiopeia.
audit.corrected: Stated the ball-relative spacing rule, the real cooldowns, the self-shield, and the fact that grounding does nothing to her.

audit.why: It is the field that carries the numbers.
audit.corrected: Shockwave 110/95/80s, Command: Attack 7/6/5/4/3s at 35 mana, Command: Protect 9s.
